say: In the early 1900s, America had bucket shops.
You could call a stock up or down, without ever owning it.
And the house took the other side of every trade.
Now they're back. On-chain.

say.say: This is Papertrade: up to a thousand times leverage on Bitcoin and Ethereum, built on Hyperliquid.
say.show: This is Papertrade: up to 1000× leverage on Bitcoin and Ethereum, built on Hyperliquid.

say: And you don't trade against other people. You trade against the house.

beats.title: One click
beats.sub: BTC or ETH · up or down · up to 1000×
beats.head: Trade ticket

say.say: Pick Bitcoin or Ethereum, up or down. Ten dollars at a thousand times trades like ten thousand.
say.show: Pick Bitcoin or Ethereum, up or down. $10 at 1000× trades like $10,000.

say: You get Hyperliquid's live price. No slippage, no funding fees.
Win, and the house pays you. Lose, and the house keeps it.

beats.title: The house
beats.sub: Where does its money come from?
beats.label: Balance
beats.src: Illustration: it only fills from traders' losses
say: Here's the wild part. The house starts with zero dollars.
No team money. No investors. Nobody can even deposit.
It only fills up from traders' losses.

beats.title: Win while it's empty?
beats.note: Margin: back at once · Profit: waits in line
say: So what if you win while the house is empty?
Your own money comes back at once. Your profit takes a number and waits in line.
First in, first paid, as other traders lose.

beats.title: Lose, get PAPER
beats.sub: Their token · the only way to get it
beats.rule: $1 lost = 100 PAPER · while the house is under $2M
say: And when you lose, you get PAPER, their token. Losing is the only way to get it.

say.say: While the house has under two million dollars, every dollar lost earns a hundred PAPER.
say.show: While the house has under $2M, every $1 lost earns 100 PAPER.

say.say: Lose ten dollars, get a thousand PAPER. Early losers get the most.
say.show: Lose $10, get 1,000 PAPER. Early losers get the most.

beats.title: PAPER owns the house
beats.label: Owned by
beats.wal_sub: a share of the house's wins
beats.last: Every PAPER comes from a loss
say: Why would you want it? Because PAPER owns the house.
Lock your PAPER in, and you earn dollars: a share of everything the house wins.
No team tokens, no investors, no airdrop. Every PAPER comes from a loss.

beats.title: The catch
cons: Built for most traders to lose
PAPER can't be sold at launch

say.say: The catch: at a thousand times, a move of just zero point zero five percent can close your trade.
say.show: The catch: at 1000×, a move of just 0.05% can close your trade.

say.say: With Bitcoin at eighty-six thousand dollars, that's about forty-three dollars.

say: It's built for most traders to lose. And PAPER can't be sold at launch.
